items.discussion: CI perf leg red at next 0e65bdc6 (todo x1.0157, walkthrough x1.0164, genapp:46 x1.0205 of the ceiling); four more 1% ci bump rows (todo, walkthrough, genapp:46, ssr), x1.0201 cumulative on those subjects, to list at the Order 58 seal
items.body: Callgrind, one machine, 3dd1109d against 0e65bdc6 (logs ~/.vilan/gates/perf-ctx/): math 264,615,719 to 264,695,908 (x1.0003); watch x1.0054; browser x1.0070; fullstack x1.0068; router x1.0065; reactive-ui x1.0067; ssr x1.0077; canvas x1.0069; rpc x1.0062; todo x1.0088; walkthrough x1.0102; genapp:46 7,517,216,321 to 7,636,572,540 (x1.0159). About 10M instructions is constant across the examples (std's own dispatch sites, so a candidate for the std prefix or a per-function cache), the rest grows with the program. Profile `DispatchEntries` construction and the per-context settling of `via` paths; keep every `inference::contexts` pin green; retire the M203 bump rows if the cost goes.
